text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The government demanded the ministries of defence and interior to look into claims that cellulars are being tapped.
-Minister of Economy Jaber: We want to amend our rules in light of international accords that protect intellectual property rights.
-Parliament Speaker Berri extends his official visit to France. He said: Resistance is the only way to change the current situation.
-Lebanon had a $426 million trade deficit in January compared with $493 million in January 1996, according to customs figures.
-The Greenpeace ship "Sirius" will visit Lebanon in July.
-Italy topped the list of countries exporting goods to Lebanon in Jaunuary.
-Catholic partiarchs and bishops announced the program of the Pope's visit to Lebanon in May.
